title: LISTEN UP! WE TRIED TO MAKE "THOSE GAMES" EVEN MORE EXTREME! SOME THINGS HAVE TO BE LEARNED THE HARD WAY!
description:
THOSE GAMES are now more challenging and more fun than ever!

Play upgraded, harder versions of minigames from THOSE GAMES 1 and 2!

Take on the minigames you know and love, now with a whole new layer of hardcore challenge

 and replayability!

THOSE GAMES EXTREME is a new, more challenging THOSE GAMES experience. Enjoy flashier

 attacks, animations, and stage gimmicks for more excitement and drama than ever!

Featuring new versions of THOSE GAMES staples, all with updated visuals, including Pin Pull,

 Number Tower, Color Lab, Knock-Back Shooter, Draw & Guard, and Spellbinding Scroll (now

 upgraded to Survival Scroll!).

Are you ready for the hardest instalment in the THOSE GAMES series yet? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!

Key Features

・A new instalment in the THOSE GAMES series, with a focus on higher difficulty.

・Features familiar minigames with updated visuals for a fresh new look.

・Enjoy bite-sized gaming challenges to your hearts' content, with 155 stages across six different minigames!

・Compete against other players from around the world in Rank-Up Challenges.

・Use the coins you earn in-game to get plates and titles from the Gotcha! machine.

・Combine plates and titles to create and customize your own Title Plate.

・View global leaderboards updated every month in Latest Rankings.

・Complete a variety of different missions to earn rewards.

*Some minigame stages from THOSE GAMES and THOSE GAMES 2 also appear in this game as tutorial stages.

New players can use these stages to get used to the mechanics before things get too crazy.

Or, if you're a THOSE GAMES veteran, skip the tutorial and get right into the extreme action!

Either way, the tutorials will always be there for you, so you can play with confidence!
description_short: THOSE GAMES are back, and harder than ever! Play upgraded, more difficult versions of familiar minigames to your heart's content! Are you up to the challenge? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!
